$comment: Hand-maintained corrections layered over the Goodreads import, keyed by slug.
Any field of the books schema may appear here; it wins over the imported value.
The Goodreads feed is accurate about the book and vague about the reading.
Two things it commonly gets wrong or omits:
finishedOn  Absent on a large share of the shelf, usually for books added
before you started recording dates. Those sort by addedOn and
stay off the reading timeline. Set it for any worth placing.
thought     Empty wherever a book was rated but not reviewed. The pages
handle that; write one here if a book deserves a line.
`npm run books:check` writes nothing and lists what would change.
